mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate QT prolongation risk with escitalopram, and impaired renal clearance may increase escitalopram levels.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and cardiac function (ECG/QTc) regularly; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly; consider escitalopram dose adjustment if renal impairment develops.
